sentences.en: A contempt finding could open the door to an investigation into whether Fauci had a valid constitutional right against self-incrimination when he refused to answer the committee's questions.
sentences.cn: 藐视法庭的认定可能为调查福奇在拒绝回答委员会问题时是否拥有反对自证其罪的合法宪法权利打开大门。
sentences.structure: 主句：A contempt finding could open the door to an investigation；介词短语 into whether... 作定语修饰 investigation；when 引导时间状语从句。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句，主句谓语为 could open，宾语为 the door，to an investigation 为介词短语作状语。whether 引导宾语从句，作 into 的宾语。when 引导时间状语从句，说明调查的时间背景。

sentences.en: Now, Senate investigators have just obtained a copy of Dr. Fauci's work iPhone from the pandemic era.
sentences.cn: 现在，参议院调查人员刚刚获得了一部福奇博士在疫情期间使用的工作iPhone。
sentences.structure: 主句：Senate investigators have just obtained a copy；of Dr. Fauci's work iPhone 为介词短语作定语；from the pandemic era 为介词短语作定语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为简单句，现在完成时表示刚刚完成的动作。a copy of 后接名词短语，from 短语说明来源。

sentences.en: I think the thing looming over this is the fact that Dr. Fauci already has a pardon.
sentences.cn: 我认为笼罩在这件事上的是福奇博士已经获得赦免这一事实。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：the thing looming over this is the fact；that 引导同位语从句解释 fact。
sentences.analysis: 本句为主从复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中主语为 the thing，looming over this 为现在分词短语作定语，系动词为 is，表语为 the fact，that 引导同位语从句。

sentences.en: Now, Democratic senators argue that having a pardon does not restrict you from using your Fifth Amendment right.
sentences.cn: 现在，民主党参议员辩称，拥有赦免并不限制你行使第五修正案权利。
sentences.structure: 主句：Democratic senators argue；that 引导宾语从句；宾语从句中主语为动名词短语 having a pardon，谓语为 does not restrict，宾语为 you，from using... 为介词短语作补语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。argue 后接 that 宾语从句。动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数。restrict sb. from doing sth. 为固定搭配。

sentences.en: And I think that's also the argument that Democrats are making that Fauci has the right to assert the Fifth Amendment against self-incrimination.
sentences.cn: 我认为这也是民主党人提出的论点，即福奇有权援引第五修正案反对自证其罪。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that's also the argument；that Democrats are making 为定语从句修饰 argument；that Fauci has the right... 为同位语从句解释 argument。
sentences.analysis: 本句为多重复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中 that's 为 that is 缩写。第一个 that 引导定语从句，第二个 that 引导同位语从句。

sentences.en: What I can do today is what I'm going to do today.
sentences.cn: 我今天能做的就是我今天要做的事。
sentences.structure: 主语从句：What I can do today；系动词：is；表语从句：what I'm going to do today。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句，包含主语从句和表语从句。what 引导主语从句，在从句中作 do 的宾语；what 引导表语从句，在从句中作 do 的宾语。

sentences.en: And if the lab leak theory is true, we're not getting to the bottom, as all of this is happening, of why there was a real gag on people not being allowed to say that that was a possibility.
sentences.cn: 如果实验室泄漏理论是真的，那么当这一切发生时，我们并没有查明真相，即为什么人们被真正封口，不允许说那是一种可能性。
sentences.structure: 条件状语从句：if the lab leak theory is true；主句：we're not getting to the bottom；as 引导时间状语从句；of why... 为介词短语作定语修饰 bottom。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。if 引导条件状语从句，as 引导时间状语从句。主句中 get to the bottom of 为固定短语，of 后接 why 引导的宾语从句。

sentences.en: It's shocking to me that Republicans are still laser focused on Anthony Fauci.
sentences.cn: 令我震惊的是，共和党人仍然高度关注安东尼·福奇。
sentences.structure: 形式主语：It；系动词：is；表语：shocking；真正主语：that 从句。
sentences.analysis: 本句为 it 作形式主语的句型。that 从句为真正主语。laser focused 为副词短语，表示“高度集中”。

sentences.en: And I think that would be true if they were actually looking for the, as Doug said, the original cause of Covid.
sentences.cn: 我认为，如果他们真的像道格所说的那样寻找新冠的原始原因，那将是正确的。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that would be true；if 引导条件状语从句；as Doug said 为插入语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中 that 指代前文内容。if 引导虚拟条件句，表示与现在事实相反。as Doug said 为插入语。

sentences.en: And so now the majority of abortions take place using medication and a slight majority of them take place with telemedicine.
sentences.cn: 因此，现在大多数堕胎使用药物进行，其中略多于一半通过远程医疗进行。
sentences.structure: 并列句：the majority of abortions take place using medication；and a slight majority of them take place with telemedicine。
sentences.analysis: 本句为并列句，由 and 连接两个分句。第一个分句主语为 the majority of abortions，谓语为 take place，using medication 为方式状语；第二个分句主语为 a slight majority of them，谓语为 take place，with telemedicine 为方式状语。

sentences.en: Because abortion medication is so safe and effective and accessible now, that is the big reason why we do not have that.
sentences.cn: 因为堕胎药物现在如此安全、有效且易于获得，这就是我们没有看到那种情况的主要原因。
sentences.structure: 原因状语从句：Because abortion medication is so safe and effective and accessible now；主句：that is the big reason；why 引导定语从句修饰 reason。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。Because 引导原因状语从句，主句为 that is the big reason，why 引导定语从句修饰 reason。

sentences.en: And so, whether, you know, when Todd Blanche says make Dobbs permanent in every state, Dobbs does not say that blue states can't have their own abortion laws that both make it legal and protect these doctors.
sentences.cn: 所以，你知道，当托德·布兰奇说让多布斯在每个州永久化时，多布斯并没有说蓝州不能有自己的堕胎法，这些法律既使其合法又保护这些医生。
sentences.structure: 主句：Dobbs does not say；that 引导宾语从句；whether 引导让步状语从句；when 引导时间状语从句；that both make it legal and protect these doctors 为定语从句修饰 laws。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。whether 引导让步状语从句，其中包含 when 引导的时间状语从句。主句为 Dobbs does not say，后接 that 宾语从句，宾语从句中又包含 that 定语从句。

sentences.en: And so the question is, is there a majority on the Supreme Court for curtailing the free flow of medication through the mail from, again, legitimate, licensed doctors in their states, sending them to desperate patients in red states?
sentences.cn: 所以问题是，最高法院是否有多数人支持限制通过邮件从合法、有执照的医生那里向红州绝望患者发送药物的自由流动？
sentences.structure: 主句：the question is；表语从句：is there a majority...；for curtailing... 为介词短语作定语；from... 和 sending... 为介词短语和现在分词短语作定语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。the question is 后接表语从句，表语从句为一般疑问句语序。for curtailing 表示目的，from 和 sending 修饰 doctors。

sentences.en: And I think that is the lane that, if he was going to run, I think it's clear that Carlson's going to run on that.
sentences.cn: 我认为这就是他的路线，如果他要参选，我认为很明显卡尔森将以此作为竞选纲领。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that is the lane；that 引导定语从句修饰 lane；if 引导条件状语从句；I think it's clear that... 为插入语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中 that is the lane，that 引导定语从句，定语从句中包含 if 条件状语从句和 I think 插入语。

sentences.en: He uniquely was able to sort of patch together the make America healthy again, these anti-war folks.
sentences.cn: 他独特地能够拼凑起“让美国再次健康”这些反战人士。
sentences.structure: 主句：He uniquely was able to sort of patch together；宾语：the make America healthy again, these anti-war folks。
sentences.analysis: 本句为简单句。be able to 后接动词原形，patch together 为固定短语，意为“拼凑”。宾语部分为两个名词短语并列。

sentences.en: And I think this is actually a window into what is going to happen post-Trump where...
sentences.cn: 我认为这实际上是了解后特朗普时代将会发生什么的窗口，在那里……
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：this is actually a window；into what... 为介词短语作定语；where 引导定语从句。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中 a window into 为固定搭配，what 引导宾语从句作 into 的宾语，where 引导定语从句修饰 window。

sentences.en: And they've both sort of fed into each other with their, you know, indignation and so forth.
sentences.cn: 他们俩都以各自的愤慨等情绪相互助长。
sentences.structure: 主句：they've both sort of fed into each other；with their indignation and so forth 为介词短语作方式状语。
sentences.analysis: 本句为简单句。feed into 为固定短语，意为“助长”。sort of 为口语表达，意为“有点”。

sentences.en: And I think that's the reality.
sentences.cn: 我认为这就是现实。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that's the reality。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句，think 后接 that 宾语从句，that 可省略。

sentences.en: And I think that's also the argument that Democrats are making that Fauci has the right to assert the Fifth Amendment against self-incrimination.
sentences.cn: 我认为这也是民主党人提出的论点，即福奇有权援引第五修正案反对自证其罪。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that's also the argument；that Democrats are making 为定语从句；that Fauci has the right... 为同位语从句。
sentences.analysis: 本句为多重复合句。think 后接宾语从句，宾语从句中 that's 为 that is 缩写。第一个 that 引导定语从句，第二个 that 引导同位语从句。

sentences.en: And I think that's the reality.
sentences.cn: 我认为这就是现实。
sentences.structure: 主句：I think；宾语从句：that's the reality。
sentences.analysis: 本句为复合句，think 后接 that 宾语从句，that 可省略。

topics.title: Fauci Contempt Vote
topics.content: 参议院委员会就福奇博士藐视国会进行投票。福奇在听证会上援引第五修正案111次，拒绝回答关于新冠处理的问题。此前他已获得拜登总统的全面赦免，但共和党人认为赦免不影响其作证义务。若认定藐视，可能移交司法部调查。
topics.keywords: contempt, Fifth Amendment, pardon, self-incrimination, Senate committee

topics.title: Abortion Policy and Telemedicine
topics.content: 代理司法部长托德·布兰奇承诺使多布斯判决在每个州永久化，并可能通过《康斯托克法》限制邮寄堕胎药。远程医疗堕胎已成为多数，但面临法律挑战。最高法院可能介入，影响跨州堕胎药流动。
topics.keywords: Dobbs, abortion pills, telemedicine, Comstock Act, shield laws

topics.title: Wisconsin Gubernatorial Race
topics.content: 民主党社会主义者弗朗西斯卡·洪在威斯康星州州长初选中领先，但因其2020年呼吁取消感恩节的帖子引发争议。她支持削减警察经费、反对ICE，并批评美国对以色列政策。进步派在蓝墙州的选举表现备受关注。
topics.keywords: gubernatorial, Democratic socialist, Thanksgiving, blue wall, primary

topics.title: Tucker Carlson and Third-Party Run
topics.content: 塔克·卡尔森举办晚宴，聚集被特朗普抛弃的MAGA成员，并讨论组建第三党。他批评特朗普对伊朗发动战争，可能利用反战情绪参加2028年总统竞选。评论员对此看法不一。
topics.keywords: Tucker Carlson, third party, anti-war, MAGA, 2028 election
